chapters.title: Synth
chapters.subtitle: Generators
chapters.blurb: Effects that make an image out of nothing but coordinates and a seed. Every program in the book starts with one of these.

chapters.title: Filter
chapters.subtitle: Processors
chapters.blurb: One image in, one image out. The largest chapter, ranging from a single multiply to multi-pass optical simulation.

chapters.title: Mixer
chapters.subtitle: Two Sources
chapters.blurb: Effects that read a second surface alongside the pipeline, and decide how the two meet.

chapters.title: Points
chapters.subtitle: Agents and Particles
chapters.blurb: State held in a texture and stepped every frame. Flocks, slime moulds, fluid, and life.

chapters.title: Render
chapters.subtitle: Pipeline Machinery
chapters.blurb: The stages that move data between the pipeline’s domains: particles to pixels, volumes to images, loops back on themselves.

chapters.title: Synth 3D
chapters.subtitle: Volumes
chapters.blurb: Generators that fill a 3D texture rather than a 2D one, then hand it to a renderer to be flattened.

chapters.title: Filter 3D
chapters.subtitle: Volume Processors
chapters.blurb: Two effects that read a volume and write a volume, before anything is projected to the screen.
